revision.title: Fix TypeScript compilation error in work.ts candidateDrift call
revision.description:
## Problem

`bunx tsc --noEmit -p session-system/tsconfig.json` fails with:
`session-system/extensions/workflow/work.ts(710,41): error TS2345: Argument of type 'string | null' is not assignable to parameter of type 'string'. Type 'null' is not assignable to type 'string'.`

Line 710 calls `candidateDrift(cwd, terminal.candidate_commit);`. `terminal` is `CloseAttempt`, whose `candidate_commit` property is typed as `string | null` in `@oh-my-pi/pi-work-client`. `candidateDrift` in `session-system/extensions/workflow/git.ts` requires `candidateCommit: string`.

## Provenance
Introduced in commit `a8de1881a8e` (OMP-174) during terminal attempt drift handling.

## Proposed Fix
In `session-system/extensions/workflow/work.ts` (or `git.ts`), guard or handle null `candidate_commit` before passing to `candidateDrift`.
acceptance_criteria: bunx tsc --noEmit -p session-system/tsconfig.json passes cleanly without error TS2345 on candidateDrift calls
candidate_commit being string | null is handled in candidateDrift or work.ts
